news.title: Fackson Next Pro & Angels Announce 2026/2027 Open Academy Trials
news.excerpt: Registration is now officially open for boys and girls across U-10, U-13, U-17, and Free Age squads.
news.content:
Fackson Football Academy management is thrilled to announce the commencement of recruitment for the upcoming 2026/2027 competitive season. Both Fackson Next Pro (Male) and Fackson Angels (Female) are scouting prospective talent who demonstrate technical promise, athletic dynamism, and sportsmanship.

Trials will take place at Meiran Field Estate - Ojokoro Housing Estate Field, Meiran Alagbado under the direct supervision of licensed coaches, European scout liaisons, and technical staff. Registered participants will undergo physical conditioning tests, 1v1 technical assessments, and full 11-a-side showcase matches.

Prospective athletes and parents are invited to fill out the online registration form through this portal.
news.author: Academy Director

news.title: Fackson Angels U17 Crowned Champions in Regional Invitational
news.excerpt: A sensational 3-1 triumph secured the golden trophy for our high-flying angels squad.
news.content:
In an electrifying finale at the City Stadium, Fackson Angels U17 produced a tactical masterclass to overcome Metropolitan Stars 3-1. Goals from Chioma Nnamdi and a brace from Maya Oladipo sealed an unforgettable victory.

Head Coach commended the discipline, tactical cohesion, and fearless attacking style that defines the Fackson Angels philosophy. "Our girls displayed elite grit and technical superiority on the biggest stage," she stated.
news.author: Head Coach Fatima

news.title: Next Pro U17 Scouting Showcase Attracts International Scouts
news.excerpt: Over 8 club scouts attended the weekend showcase at the Fackson Complex.
news.content:
The talent pipeline at Fackson Next Pro was on full display this weekend as scouts from prestigious European and regional clubs observed our U17 and Free Age squads. Emmanuel Fackson delivered a stand-out performance that earned widespread praise.

The academy continues its mission to provide a direct pathway from youth grassroots football to professional careers.
news.author: Chief Scout
